name: Container Orchestration Platform
description: The Kubernetes control plane enforces a critical trust boundary between workload-level and administrative-level access. Weaknesses in API server authentication, RBAC lateral propagation, etcd access control, admission webhook bypass, and cross-tenant segmentation allow attackers to escape workload trust constraints and achieve cluster-wide administrative control. Effective zone enforcement requires strict ingress/egress filtering at each control plane surface, isolated credential domains per trust zone, and complete admission chain coverage.
